posts.author: Stereofan
posts.content_md: I know I've seen search info on underwater holographic cameras (viz., plankton); does anyone know what the advances are here? What it would take to do underwater holography? What adjustments must be made? Uniquenesses?

posts.author: ron olson
posts.content_md: Big Q-switched lasers are much happier on land hence I would advise "throughwater" imaging as opposed to "underwater" imaging. With the help of the Steinhart Aquarium in San Francisco, we produced ~ 10 marine images that we sold with our PortHol frames. For these we used a customized (large and thin) 75 gallon tank. Very interesting project determining which fishes, mollusks and invertebrates could deal with red safelight long enough for me to get a decent composition. I intend to revisit marine holography for use with laser back-lighting. Green and blue lasers transmit beautifully through water and holographic back panels make for some very interesting effects.
